name: E-Commerce: Payment Gateway & Fraud Risk core scenarios
description: Evaluation scenarios for E-Commerce: Payment Gateway & Fraud Risk.

parts.text: What is our overall payment authorization rate and breakdown by processor?
Based on payment transaction logs, CyberSource leads with a 98.1% authorization rate, followed by Stripe at 97.8%, Adyen at 96.5%, and PayPal at 94.2%.
Which dispute reason codes are driving our chargeback losses and what is our dispute win rate?
Fraud (code 10.4_FRAUD) is the primary driver of chargebacks representing $1,040 in disputed volume, with an overall representment win rate of 75.0% on resolved disputes.
What percentage of 3D Secure challenges are abandoned by mobile users?
Mobile users experience a 66.7% abandonment rate when presented with a step-up 3DS challenge, compared to 0% abandonment on desktop browser sessions.
How do our payment gateway authorization rates and fraud false positive rates compare to industry benchmarks?
Our aggregate authorization rate of 96.6% exceeds the retail e-commerce industry benchmark of 95.0%, and our false positive rate remains under the industry threshold of 5.0%.
